extras.d: With striking blue hair, Karen is the authoritative district manager of Pufferfish Corp., ensuring everything runs smoothly.
Always on the move, Ratih is a traveling merchant known for her diverse colletion of goods.
Derek is a hardworking construction worker who can often be seen at various building sites around town.
The secretary at Pufferfish Corp., handling day-to-day tasks with ease.
Working diligently for Funlop, the town rank agency, Judge Ross upholds the rankings and standards of the town.
A revered guru within the B.O.S., Jio Dan imparts wisdom and guidance to his fellow hunters.
A wandering member of B.O.S., Axel Malenalopez can be found journeying to various parts of the realm.
A member of BOS who resides in an undisclosed location, keeping many guessing.
The renowned farmer, Jeff Smith, not only heads the prestigious farming guild but also charms audiences on his farming show.
Hailing from Belunga Bay, Bobby is a farmer with an inherited fortune. Often perceived as boastful and lazy, he's known more for showing off than working the land.
As the supreme entity of Coral Isalnd, the Goddess resides majestically within the lake, watching over all.
The youngest of four siblings, Eddy trails behind Aaliyah, Frank, and Noah. Works for a start-up.
Towers above most with his height and is often recognized by his stylish hat.
Only emerging under the veil of night, Lele is a travelling merchant with a trove of nocturnal treasures.
Takeba is the keeper of the hot spring.
A tourist who supported our project of Kickstarter and is also a founder of Coral Island.
A tourist who supported our project of Kickstarter and is also a founder of Coral Island.
A tourist who supported our project of Kickstarter and is also a founder of Coral Island.
A tourist who supported our project of Kickstarter and is also a founder of Coral Island.
A tourist who supported our project of Kickstarter and is also a founder of Coral Island.
A tourist who supported our project of Kickstarter and is also a founder of Coral Island.
A tourist who supported our project of Kickstarter and is also a founder of Coral Island.
A tourist who supported our project of Kickstarter and is also a founder of Coral Island.
Standing vigilant, Deno is the dedicated guard of the Merfolk Kingdom, ensuring its safety from intruders.

Galoong, the talented Decor Seller, is the go-to merfolk for anyone wanting to beautify their homes. He and his partner, Vihren, are both expert sculptors, and their shared passion for their craft deepens their bond.

The charismatic Owner of the Sleepy Eel Tavern, Jannu is known for his welcoming demeanor and knack for storytelling. His tavern is a favorite gathering spot for jerrold looking to unwind and share tales of the sea.
The vibrant and stylish Clothes Seller, Lalin has an eye for fashion and a knack for making everyone feel fabulous in her unique designs.
As the heart of the General Shop, Lawu brings warmth and efficiency to the bustling marketplace. She's the perfect partner to her husband, Todi, ensuring the shop runs smoothly.
The friendly face of the General Shop, Todi is always ready with a smile and a great deal. He and his wife, Lawu, work side by side to serve their community.
A gifted sculptor with a modest demeanor. When he's not creating beautiful works of art, he enjoys s[ending evenings at the local tavern with his partner, Galoong, dancing to the lively music.
Luke's little buddy, Taco, loves to dive into waters regardless of the season and enjoy a good nap afterwards.
Erika and Frank's cherished cat. Its fluffiness is hard to resist.
Erika and Frank's beloved cat, but there's a whisper among friends that Butter might be Erika's top favorite.
Zoe, Mark, Paul, and Anne's mini labradoodle. Known to wander and explore on its own.
Nestled in a forest shack, this monkey not only displays an oddly worried demeanor but also hoards a collection of rare and intriguing items.
In the heart of the bamboo forest, Pandazen can be found serenading the surroundings with melodies from his flute.
Surprisingly large in stature, King Tan often behaves more like an infant than a ruler, much to the bemusement of others.
Master of all slimes.
A gentle apparition, Poci roams the realms between the living and the departed.
A spirit, its purpose and history remain a mystery to all.
A wise-looking turtle who drapes a net scarf around his neck.
Distinguished by a hat made of an upcycled plastic bottle, Mantle is an advocate for environmental fashion.
This turtle sports a vibrant shell beanie, a testament to her unique style.
Adorned with artful tattoos on its fins, this beluga's markings tell tales of oceanic adventures.
Donning an eye-catching belt, many wonder about its origin and yearn for just like it.
Atop its head sits an oddity-a water bottle with a Pufferfish logo. How did it get there?
A majestic underwater dragon.
The cherished baby Naga, she's one of Princess Miranjani's treasured pets.
Dangling from Ocka's limbs are numerous bracelets, each with its own tale.
Known for its benevolent grin, this shark's smile is said to light up even the gloomiest waters.
This crustacean always appears grumpy, as if he woke up on the wrong side of the ocean bed.
With melancholic eyes, Aang is a fish that seems to harbor deep-seated sorrows.
A regal creature, this is another of Princess Miranjani's beloved pets.
A fluffy ash-brown cat with a notable slash of darker fur across its face.
With a flowing mix of brown, white, and black fur, this long-haired dog sports pristine white paws and a striking white streak down the face.
A marble-colored fox with a lush white fluffy chest and contrasting black ears. Charming.
A warm brown bunny that stands out with its snowy white chest, often giving the appearance of wearing a plush vest.
With its lush, fluffy white fur and soulful brown eyes make this cat the perfect cuddle companion.
Bold, black, and flaunting that white chest patch, this cat's got the "mewow" factor!
Stripes are always in style, and this playful cat rocks them like a superstar on the catwalk!
Check out those ears! A spirited dog with pristine white fur, contrasted by the stark black ears.
Heart eyes for days! This rabbit's pink heart-shaped fur patch is the stuff of bunny love legends.
A mesmerizing black and white fox, the long, two-toned tail flows behind like a regal banner.
This fluffy white beauty doesn't go anywhere without the trendy pink necklace.
This black cat's distinguishing feature is the brownish-ash patches that sit like eyebrows above the eyes, giving this cat a perpetually intrigued expression.
Bright and alert, this yellow lizard often seen sunning on the rocks.
With the light brown coat and notably large ears, this fox exudes an air of curiousity and alertness.
Sporting brown and black patterns, this cat might just be the secret agent of the feline world - suave and oh-so-mysterious!
Luxuriously fluffy with a grayish hue and distinct black-striped arms.
With a distinctive white chest patch, this black cat is forever ready for a black-tie gala. So posh!
The dramatic black patch over one eye and sprinkled dots on its body hint at a mischievous personality.
A large black dog with a standout white chest and small ears. A short-haired darling.
A sleek black cat, its appearance is punctuated by two stark white dots on the chest. It's an air of sophistication.
A mythical pet.
